text:
cheng: Heads-up — eu-west-1 GPU cluster has been at ~95% utilization for the last 40m and queue depth for shared pools is 3x normal. P99 latency jumped, lots of tail.
alex: any tenant ids standing out?
cheng: t-342 + a few ad-hoc batch rerank jobs (long contexts) are hot. KV cache churn high -> cold misses amplifying token cost. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/eu-west1/slots (link).
maria: is this noise (short spikes) or sustained?
cheng: sustained. started ~1962341200, stayed high. Not a single thundering herd but small number of heavy runs keeping capacity pinned.
sam: proposal: soft regional preempt policy + per-tenant ingress throttles. Let overloaded tenant continue but slow to fair-share level; if sustained, move new allocations into preemptible/burst pool.
ellie: cost caveat — moving to smaller preemptible pool reduces batching efficiency, might increase token cost by ~10-20% per token. Need cost vs availability tradeoff.
cheng: agree. want to avoid full hard-preempt because customer SLA on dedicated vs reserved might be impacted. Thinking: 1) ingress token-bucket at router, 2) per-tenant backlog weight, 3) ephemeral lease to let long-running KV-heavy jobs finish with degraded throughput.
alex: can you sketch a policy?
cheng: short sketch:
```
# pseudocode ingress policy
if cluster_util > CLUSTER_HIGH and tenant_load_factor > TENANT_HEAVY:
  apply_token_bucket(tenant, rate = baseline_rate * tenant_weight)
  if backlog_growth_rate > BACKLOG_HIGH:
    mark_allocations(new) -> preemptible_pool
    set_lease(ttl=lease_seconds, mode=best-effort)
```

maria: +1. add a KV-cache TTL bump for tenants flagged as heavy (shorter TTL -> less mem churn) as a low-cost mitigation before moving pools.
ops-bot: [alert] eu-west-1 shared-pool saturation: 95% util, queue_depth=312, incident_id=INC-196234.
sam: we should also surface a fairness signal in Console: per-tenant effective throughput %, expected vs actual, and a transient "soft-limited" badge. Helps engineers understand why tail latency increased.
ellie: also record cost delta in rollout so SRE/finance can revert if cost exceed threshold.
alex: how do we choose tenant_weight? committed_tier + historical_slo_compliance?
cheng: propose formula: weight = base_weight * (1 + committed_factor) * slo_penalty where slo_penalty reduces weight for tenants causing SLO violations on others. Keep it conservative.
maria: pilot plan: enable ingress throttles on 5% of eu-west shared hosts for 24h, monitor p99, backlog, and per-tenant throughput; start with rate = 0.7 * baseline. If p99 improves and cost delta < 12%, expand.
sam: assign: @maria run sim + pilot config, @cheng write rollout playbook + fallback steps, @alex add telemetry tiles for "soft-limited" and cost delta.
ellie: ping finance for provisional budget for pilot.
cheng: one more thing — need a fast fallback: if pilot causes customer-visible errors, auto-revert via deploy-bot. Add runbook step.
ops-bot: [autoscaler] recommended +3 preemptible nodes in eu-west-1 (non-blocking).
maria: copying notes into infra-runbooks/soft-regional-preempt.md and will open a short PR with configs.
sam: :thumbsup: timeline?
maria: aim to start simulation tomorrow 09:00 UTC, pilot in 48h if sims look sane.
ellie: please CC on postmortem if we go to pilot.
cheng: thanks all — will post short status update here before enabling pilot.
